# ADHD-behandlingspakke

The ADHD-behandlingspakke ("ADHD treatment package") is a standardized treatment offering for adult ADHD patients in Denmark, referenced in the ADHD-databasens 2024 annual report in connection with Indikator 9, the indicator that measures the share of adult ADHD patients who receive psychotherapy within one year of starting treatment. The report notes that the current version of the package comprises only 9 hours in total, and that this scope is not sufficient to incorporate psychotherapy [^src1]. This structural limitation is presented as a key clinical-rationale explanation for why implementation of Indikator 9 has struggled.

The broader context, per the report, is stark: Indikator 9 was first implemented on 1 April 2024, and the 2024 annual report covers only patients whose treatment course began between 1 April 2024 and 31 July 2024. Across this period, the national fulfilment rate was just 1% among 786 patients, far below the development target of 90%, a gap the report attributes to a systemic lack of ADHD-directed psychotherapy offerings in Denmark. Given this shortfall, the governing steering group (styregruppen) decided to keep the indicator in place but to prioritize implementation of Indikator 8 first, before turning full attention to Indikator 9. The 9-hour scope of the ADHD-behandlingspakke is cited as one of the structural reasons this indicator has been so hard to meet.

ADHD-behandlingspakke is mentioned once in the corpus, with a single supporting claim about its 9-hour scope and its incompatibility with incorporating psychotherapy [^src1]. No relationships or timeline events specific to this entity are recorded in the available data.
